title: One update item
description: One row per (source, item, available version). A pull request is one carrier of an item, not the item. Reference: .agents/reference/upgrade-records.md. Validated by scripts/upgrade-agent/schema/record-format.mjs, which implements only the JSON Schema keywords used here and refuses any other.

id.description: Stable key: '<source>:' plus the first 24 hex digits of sha256 over [source, item.repo, the sorted [name, to] pairs of item.packages (or [[item.name, available.version]] when there are no packages), the place: the sorted carrier.files, the paths the update changes]. One update in one place. The place is a fact of the pull request alone, not the lane's targets (those come through rules that keep being tuned). A file list GitHub cut off ends in '<file list truncated>', so the id says so. itemId() in record-format.mjs computes it; the validator refuses an id that does not match. Only the writer derives ids: a reader treats an id as opaque and never recomputes it.

item.description: What is updated: the package, image, entity, device or credential, the repository and the apps it lands in.

targets.description: Repository paths of the apps the update lands in (the lane's targets), for readers. Not part of the id.

own_images.description: Ids from own_images in upgrade-rules.json whose source this update changes.

update_type.description: The lane's update_type: '+'-joined tokens such as patch, minor, major, digest, pin, pinDigest; or firmware, expiry, unknown.

basis.description: What age_days counts from: when available was published, when the item was first seen (a lower bound), or unknown.

approval.description: RESERVED. Empty in piece 1: by Tom's ruling (saga 547 comment 6922) every approval goes through the dev-env v2 approval framework in piece 2, and piece 1 reads no approval. Piece 2 defines the fields. A GitHub review is not an approval.

attempts.description: One entry per attempt, built from the item's events (applyEvent() in record-format.mjs), the newest 20 at most: older ones are dropped and counted in attempts_dropped, so a PR refused on every tick cannot grow an item without limit.

attempts_dropped.description: How many of the oldest attempts were dropped to keep attempts at 20. The kept ones are numbered after them.

coverage.description: Honesty: read = the whole item was read; partial = some facts failed to read; unread = nothing could be read, and then the state is unknown.

lane_detail.description: The night lane's own detail, copied as written. Its shape belongs to lane-classify.mjs and run-night.mjs.

ran_at.description: When the head's checks ran: the earliest start of the counted attempts (R7, story 550).

reference_time.description: The earlier of the head commit's date and ran_at: what main is compared against.

main_newer.description: Set by the tick for lane-A records: main commits to the PR's files newer than reference_time.

via_components.description: Shared components the PR changes and the consumer directories they reach ('<component> -> <consumer>', R8).

cluster_wide.description: Ids of cluster_wide_targets the PR reaches (R5): a change that reaches every namespace.

gates.description: Tonight's gates (lane-A records only): namespaces, blockers, alerts_not_blocking, would_be_eligible.

last_attempt.description: The tick's merge-step verdict for this PR, as written (at, mode, chosen, verdict, pr_refusals, lane_refusals, merge_call); empty when the step did not run on it. Not the item's attempts: a live verdict becomes events (eventsFromMergeStep in record-format.mjs).

retry.description: Story 549: the stalled-check retry for this PR as the lane read it (state, why, count_7d, limits, history), from data.retry_ledger on upgrade-lane-state. A Renovate rebase, not an attempt on the item.

name.description: BOUND: a name, a version, a path or an id: at most 300 characters. The writer cuts a longer one with a visible mark (fit() in record-format.mjs), never refuses it.

text.description: BOUND: free text (a reason, a detail, a finding, a merge call, a refusal): at most 1000 characters, cut with a visible mark.

text_or_empty.description: BOUND: free text that may be empty: at most 1000 characters.

names.description: BOUND: a list of names: at most 100, cut with a visible last entry.

texts.description: BOUND: a list of free texts: at most 100, cut with a visible last entry.

source.description: Written in piece 1 by the night lane: renovate-pr, image-pin, own-image. The others are named in ui.md section 3 and have no writer yet.

lane.description: Who acts. From the lane record: A-night (LANE-A, and BLOCKED once its blocker clears), B-agent, B-owner, excluded; unknown when the lane could not decide. Others: auto (Renovate auto-merge), hand (a session delivers it), none (visibility only).

state.description: See upgrade-states.v1.json. approved and scheduled are reserved for piece 2 and refused by the validator.

version_kind.description: semver = dotted numbers (an exact pin such as ==1.2.3 counts); digest = a hex digest; date; other; unknown = no version.

kind.description: unknown: who acted could not be established (another bot, say); login keeps what GitHub gave.

carrier.description: The pull request that carries the item, as last seen.

files.description: The PR's changed files, sorted into the id (the place). A list GitHub cut off ends in '<file list truncated>'.

at.description: Time of the attempt's latest event.

recovery.description: After a revert: whether recovery was verified.
